Unusual Pizza
By: Usha Chowdhary Gupta
Published: Friday, December 31, 2010 - 6:06am

Ingredients




1 Large Size Potato, cut into slices,
1 Tomato, blanched and cut,
2 tablespoons Oil,
1 Onion chopped,
4 tablespoons Capsicum chopped,
2 tablespoons Corn,
1 tablespoon Tomato Sauce,
1 teaspoon Garlic chopped,
1 teaspoon Chilly n Garlic Sauce,
1 teaspoon Herbs, Chilly flakes n Oregano,
2 tablespoons Cheese grated,
A pinch Sugar,
Salt, Red chilly pd and Pepper pd to taste

Preparation

1 Wash, peel and make slices of the potato. 2 Apply one drop oil on each slice, sprinkle some salt, 3 Chilly pd, pepper pd and herbs. Put all slices in a 4 Greased tray and in a preheated oven at 150 degree, 5 For 5 minutes. 6 Make a pizza sauce, so put a pan to heat add little oil 7 In that add some cut onion, garlic, capsicum, stir for few 8 Seconds. Then add the blanched tomato, both sauces, herbs, 9 Salt, pepper pd and sugar. Let it cool then grind in a mixer 10 Jar. Again put to heat so that it can thicken. 11 Put a pan to heat add little oil in that some onion, capsicum, 12 Corn, salt, pepper pd, chilly pd, herbs and chilly flakes. 13 Now on the potato pizza type base apply some tomato pizza 14 Sauce, spread some onion|corn topping and grated cheese. 15 Put in oven at 150 degree centigrade for 5-8 minutes, check if done. 16 SERVE HOT INSTANT , QUICK PIZZAS…..
